is diagnosed with osteopenia, the registered dietitian would 
recommend supplementation with the Adequate Intake (AI)

Furthermore, the RD would support this recommendation with 
instructions on appropriate sources of supplements to maximize
absorption and utilization as well as any speciﬁ c guidelines on 
potential drug-nutrient interactions. Resources to assist with this
decision-making process are included in the web links at the end
of this chapter.
